analysis: The supplied units are BASE-side text of docs/developer/test.md (lines 1-920). The patch only adds a docs section at head lines 1043-1085 ('Cluster Pair Coordinated Update'), describing ClusterPairUpdateTests and ClusterServiceUpdateTests. The change is documentation only: no code, keys, authorization, attestation, encryption or coordinator contract is modified. The new text describes test coverage for a coordinated two-Mac update cycle (staging, admission close, drain bound, rollback, start check of a candidate's `darkbloom --version`). It touches the update/rollback area (T-013, T-043, TB-003) only as test documentation; it does not alter any control or weaken a stated assumption. The patch excerpt is truncated, and the cluster pair update implementation, its partner-to-partner trust and the coordinator-served release verification are not in the supplied evidence. I did not verify those, nor whether the threat model needs an entry for the pair-update protocol (the partner is asked whether it has automatic updates off, and it 'goes on alone' when the partner cannot be asked). That is a possible threat-model gap, but this PR shows no code for it, so I record it as an unverified contract rather than a finding. The base text examined contains no secrets or security-relevant instruction changes. The docs reference only synthetic credentials, isolated state and non-production endpoints, consistent with the threat model's test-isolation assumptions. No regression identified in the supplied lines.
